source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As the opposing player's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts, 1 **PSYKER** model of yours with this ability may use it. If it does, pick 1 enemy unit up to 18" from it and roll a D6:

- On a 1, D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** are dealt to the **PSYKER** model.
- On a 2–5, attacks by the enemy unit's models get −1 to the **Hit roll** until the phase ends.
- On a 6, attacks by the enemy unit's models get −1 to the Hit roll and −1 to the **Wound roll** for the rest of the phase.
